items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: I had George Hartman played bass and trumpet doubled, and Roger Johnson, who was deceased, played drums, and Charlie Hewitt played piano. And Jackie Blaine sang, and the boy was Billy McCree, Irish tenor.

ctx.x: Well who was there with you at the famous door?

I had George Hartman played bass and trumpet doubled, and Roger Johnson, who was deceased, played drums, and Charlie Hewitt played piano. And Jackie Blaine sang, and the boy was Billy McCree, Irish tenor. And we had to play everything that Schalke didn't play, just the opposite. That was my orders, don't play Andy Dixieland. Don't encroach on Schalke's territory.
How old was Roger Johnson when he died? He was quite young.
